// Resolve a direct forum URL through persisted server provenance. Never infer a
// public UUID from a native thread relationship or create a catalogue alias.
import {record,PublicApiContractError} from '../validation';
import {nativeThreadId,nativeDiscussionTarget,type NativeDiscussionTarget} from './context';
export interface NativeDiscussionContextDependencies {
 fetch:typeof fetch;
 origin():string;
 setTimer(callback:()=>void,ms:number):ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
 clearTimer(timer:ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>):void;
}
export const NATIVE_DISCUSSION_CONTEXT_LIMITS=Object.freeze({bytes:16*1024,fragments:4096,emptyFragments:128,deadlineMs:10000,cleanupMs:250});
export class NativeDiscussionContextUnsettled extends PublicApiContractError {
 readonly unsettled=true;
 constructor(status=499){super('Discussion target lookup cleanup is unconfirmed. New lookups are stopped until pending fetch, read and cancellation work settles. Browser login remains separate.',status);}
}
const defaults:NativeDiscussionContextDependencies={fetch:(...args)=>fetch(...args),origin:()=>window.location.origin,setTimer:(callback,ms)=>setTimeout(callback,ms),clearTimer:timer=>clearTimeout(timer)};
function fail(message:string,status=502):never{throw new PublicApiContractError(message,status);}
export function createNativeDiscussionTargetReader(injected:Partial<NativeDiscussionContextDependencies>={}) {
 const deps={...defaults,...injected};
 // The exported production singleton retains this slot across view unmounts,
 // retries and route changes. Caller timeout never releases underlying work.
 let active:object|undefined;
 return async(threadInput:string,signal?:AbortSignal,assertCurrent=()=>{}):Promise<NativeDiscussionTarget|null>=>{
  const threadId=nativeThreadId(threadInput),origin=new URL(deps.origin()).origin;
  assertCurrent();
  if(active)throw new NativeDiscussionContextUnsettled();
  const owner=active={},abort=new AbortController();
  let timedOut=false,eof=false,noTarget=false,response:Response|undefined,reader:ReadableStreamDefaultReader<Uint8Array>|undefined;
  let fetchWork:Promise<Response>|undefined,readWork:Promise<ReadableStreamReadResult<Uint8Array>>|undefined;
  let timer:ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>|undefined;
  const cancelled=()=>new PublicApiContractError(timedOut?'Discussion target lookup exceeded its 10-second deadline':'Discussion target lookup cancelled',timedOut?504:499);
  let rejectAbort:(reason:unknown)=>void=()=>{};
  const aborted=new Promise<never>((_resolve,reject)=>{rejectAbort=reject;});void aborted.catch(()=>{});
  const onAbort=()=>rejectAbort(cancelled()),cancel=()=>abort.abort();
  abort.signal.addEventListener('abort',onAbort,{once:true});
  signal?.addEventListener('abort',cancel,{once:true});if(signal?.aborted)cancel();
  const check=()=>{assertCurrent();if(signal?.aborted||abort.signal.aborted)throw cancelled();if(new URL(deps.origin()).origin!==origin)fail('Discussion target destination changed',409);};
  const release=()=>{reader?.releaseLock();if(active===owner)active=undefined;};
  try {
   check();
   timer=deps.setTimer(()=>{timedOut=true;abort.abort();},NATIVE_DISCUSSION_CONTEXT_LIMITS.deadlineMs);
   fetchWork=Promise.resolve().then(()=>{
    check();
    return deps.fetch(origin+'/api/v1/nostr/native-forum/threads/'+encodeURIComponent(threadId)+'/context',{method:'GET',credentials:'omit',cache:'no-store',redirect:'error',signal:abort.signal,headers:{Accept:'application/json'}});
   }).then(value=>{response=value;return value;});
   response=await Promise.race([fetchWork,aborted]);check();
   if(response.status===404){noTarget=true;return null;}
   if(response.status!==200)fail('Signed discussion target lookup unavailable (HTTP '+response.status+'). Browser login remains separate.',response.status);
   if(response.headers.get('content-type')?.split(';',1)[0].trim().toLowerCase()!=='application/json')fail('Discussion target lookup returned a non-JSON response');
   const limit=NATIVE_DISCUSSION_CONTEXT_LIMITS.bytes,declared=response.headers.get('content-length');
   if(declared!==null&&(!/^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(declared)||Number(declared)>limit))fail('Discussion target lookup exceeds its response budget');
   reader=response.body?.getReader();if(!reader)fail('Discussion target lookup returned no response body');
   // One fixed allocation, never retained fragment arrays or repeated string
   // concatenation. Byte, total-fragment and empty-fragment limits are separate.
   const bytes=new Uint8Array(limit);let length=0,fragments=0,empty=0;
   for(;;){
    check();if(++fragments>NATIVE_DISCUSSION_CONTEXT_LIMITS.fragments)fail('Discussion target lookup exceeds its fragment budget');
    readWork=Promise.resolve().then(()=>{check();return reader!.read();}).then(part=>{if(part.done)eof=true;return part;});
    const part=await Promise.race([readWork,aborted]);check();if(part.done)break;
    if(!(part.value instanceof Uint8Array)||part.value.byteLength>limit-length)fail('Discussion target lookup exceeds its response budget');
    if(!part.value.byteLength&&++empty>NATIVE_DISCUSSION_CONTEXT_LIMITS.emptyFragments)fail('Discussion target lookup exceeds its empty-fragment budget');
    bytes.set(part.value,length);length+=part.value.byteLength;
   }
   const text=new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}).decode(bytes.subarray(0,length));check();
   const body=record(JSON.parse(text),'native discussion context'),meta=record(body.nostr),data=record(body.data);
   if(body.result!=='ok'||meta.source!=='persisted-native-discussion-target')fail('Discussion target lacks persisted native provenance');
   const target=nativeDiscussionTarget({kind:data.kind,targetId:data.id,threadId:data.threadId},threadId);
   check();return target;
  } finally {
   if(timer!==undefined)deps.clearTimer(timer);
   signal?.removeEventListener('abort',cancel);abort.signal.removeEventListener('abort',onAbort);
   if(eof){
    // Clean EOF is terminal even when later JSON/provenance validation fails.
    // Do not retroactively abort or cancel an already consumed healthy body.
    try{release();}catch{throw new NativeDiscussionContextUnsettled();}
   }else{
    if(!noTarget)abort.abort();
    const cleanup=(async()=>{
     // Chain late response ownership, rather than snapshotting a mutable set.
     // A fetch ignoring abort still owns its eventual body cancellation.
     if(fetchWork)await fetchWork.catch(()=>undefined);
     if(!reader&&response?.body)reader=response.body.getReader();
     if(reader)await Promise.allSettled([Promise.resolve().then(()=>reader!.cancel()),...(readWork?[readWork]:[])]);
     release();
    })();
    // This observer and owner survive the finite caller grace period. Rejected
    // cancellation is terminal; an unsettled operation or failed release is not.
    const settled=cleanup.then(()=>true,()=>false);
    let cleanupTimer:ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>|undefined;
    try{
     if(!await Promise.race([settled,new Promise<boolean>(resolve=>{cleanupTimer=deps.setTimer(()=>resolve(false),NATIVE_DISCUSSION_CONTEXT_LIMITS.cleanupMs);})]))throw new NativeDiscussionContextUnsettled(timedOut?504:499);
     if(noTarget)check();
    }finally{if(cleanupTimer!==undefined)deps.clearTimer(cleanupTimer);}
   }
  }
 };
}
export const readNativeDiscussionTarget=createNativeDiscussionTargetReader();
